title: Specific problem in an observed configuration
problem: Expected behavior, actual behavior, and established trigger.
causal_principle: General mechanism, separately from local commands. Unverified explanations stay candidates.

context.architecture: Relevant components, boundaries, and state model

applicability.rationale: Why these conditions matter; one incident remains scoped to its observed project/configuration.

counterexamples: An architecture or version where the same symptom has a different cause.

diagnostic_checks: Independent checks distinguishing this cause from similar symptoms.

correction.principle: Smallest authorized change to the demonstrated cause
project_specific: Optional sanitized example commands/paths; examples only, recheck before adaptation.

invariants: Supported behavior, safety checks, state and permission boundaries to preserve.

failure_evidence: Sanitized reproduction or existing evidence reference
cause_evidence: Observed causal evidence, not just temporal correlation
verification.regression_check: Check and outcome, or why unnecessary/unavailable
verification.attribution: User/task attribution if feedback; otherwise not applicable

source.revision: Originating source revision or explicit unavailable reason

status_reason: Why this status is justified within its recorded scope
